Definition context : Type := list ( atom * (grade * tm) ).

Fixpoint open_tm_wrt_tm_rec (k:nat) (a5:tm) (a_6:tm) {struct a_6}: tm :=
  match a_6 with
  | a_TyUnit => a_TyUnit
  | a_TmUnit => a_TmUnit
  | (a_Pi psi A B) => a_Pi psi (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 A) (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec (S k) a5 B)
  | (a_Abs psi A a) => a_Abs psi (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 A) (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec (S k) a5 a)
  | (a_App a psi b) => a_App (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 a) psi (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 b)
  | (a_Type s) => a_Type s
  | (a_Var_b nat) =>
      match lt_eq_lt_dec nat k with
        | inleft (left _) => a_Var_b nat
        | inleft (right _) => a5
        | inright _ => a_Var_b (nat - 1)
      end
  | (a_Var_f x) => a_Var_f x
  | (a_CEq psi a b psi0 A) => a_CEq psi (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 a) (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 b) psi0 (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 A)
  | a_Refl => a_Refl
  | (a_Transp a b) => a_Transp (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 a) (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 b)
  | (a_T psi A) => a_T psi (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 A)
  | (a_Box psi a) => a_Box psi (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 a)
  | (a_Unbox psi a) => a_Unbox psi (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 a)
  | (a_SSigma psi A B) => a_SSigma psi (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 A) (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec (S k) a5 B)
  | (a_SPair a psi b) => a_SPair (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 a) psi (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 b)
  | (a_Proj1 psi a) => a_Proj1 psi (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 a)
  | (a_Proj2 psi a) => a_Proj2 psi (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 a)
  | a_Bool => a_Bool
  | a_True => a_True
  | a_False => a_False
  | (a_If a b0 b1) => a_If (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 a) (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 b0) (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 b1)
end.

Definition open_tm_wrt_tm a5 a_6 := open_tm_wrt_tm_rec 0 a_6 a5.

Fixpoint close_tm_wrt_tm_rec (k:nat) (a5:var) (a_6:tm) {struct a_6}: tm :=
  match a_6 with
  | a_TyUnit => a_TyUnit
  | a_TmUnit => a_TmUnit
  | (a_Pi psi A B) => a_Pi psi (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 A) (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec (S k) a5 B)
  | (a_Abs psi A a) => a_Abs psi (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 A) (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec (S k) a5 a)
  | (a_App a psi b) => a_App (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 a) psi (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 b)
  | (a_Type s) => a_Type s
  | (a_Var_b nat) =>
       if (lt_dec nat k)
         then a_Var_b nat
         else a_Var_b (S nat)
  | (a_Var_f x) => if (a5 === x) then (a_Var_b k) else (a_Var_f x)
  | (a_CEq psi a b psi0 A) => a_CEq psi (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 a) (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 b) psi0 (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 A)
  | a_Refl => a_Refl
  | (a_Transp a b) => a_Transp (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 a) (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 b)
  | (a_T psi A) => a_T psi (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 A)
  | (a_Box psi a) => a_Box psi (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 a)
  | (a_Unbox psi a) => a_Unbox psi (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 a)
  | (a_SSigma psi A B) => a_SSigma psi (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 A) (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec (S k) a5 B)
  | (a_SPair a psi b) => a_SPair (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 a) psi (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 b)
  | (a_Proj1 psi a) => a_Proj1 psi (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 a)
  | (a_Proj2 psi a) => a_Proj2 psi (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 a)
  | a_Bool => a_Bool
  | a_True => a_True
  | a_False => a_False
  | (a_If a b0 b1) => a_If (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 a) (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 b0) (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 b1)
end.

Definition close_tm_wrt_tm a_6 a5 := close_tm_wrt_tm_rec 0 a_6 a5.

Inductive lc_tm : tm -> Prop :=
 | lc_a_TyUnit :
     (lc_tm a_TyUnit)
 | lc_a_TmUnit :
     (lc_tm a_TmUnit)
 | lc_a_Pi : forall (psi:grade) (A B:tm),
     (lc_tm A) ->
      ( forall x , lc_tm  ( open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     (lc_tm (a_Pi psi A B))
 | lc_a_Abs : forall (psi:grade) (A a:tm),
     (lc_tm A) ->
      ( forall x , lc_tm  ( open_tm_wrt_tm a (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     (lc_tm (a_Abs psi A a))
 | lc_a_App : forall (a:tm) (psi:grade) (b:tm),
     (lc_tm a) ->
     (lc_tm b) ->
     (lc_tm (a_App a psi b))
 | lc_a_Type : forall (s:sort),
     (lc_tm (a_Type s))
 | lc_a_Var_f : forall (x:tmvar),
     (lc_tm (a_Var_f x))
 | lc_a_CEq : forall (psi:grade) (a b:tm) (psi0:grade) (A:tm),
     (lc_tm a) ->
     (lc_tm b) ->
     (lc_tm A) ->
     (lc_tm (a_CEq psi a b psi0 A))
 | lc_a_Refl :
     (lc_tm a_Refl)
 | lc_a_Transp : forall (a b:tm),
     (lc_tm a) ->
     (lc_tm b) ->
     (lc_tm (a_Transp a b))
 | lc_a_T : forall (psi:grade) (A:tm),
     (lc_tm A) ->
     (lc_tm (a_T psi A))
 | lc_a_Box : forall (psi:grade) (a:tm),
     (lc_tm a) ->
     (lc_tm (a_Box psi a))
 | lc_a_Unbox : forall (psi:grade) (a:tm),
     (lc_tm a) ->
     (lc_tm (a_Unbox psi a))
 | lc_a_SSigma : forall (psi:grade) (A B:tm),
     (lc_tm A) ->
      ( forall x , lc_tm  ( open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     (lc_tm (a_SSigma psi A B))
 | lc_a_SPair : forall (a:tm) (psi:grade) (b:tm),
     (lc_tm a) ->
     (lc_tm b) ->
     (lc_tm (a_SPair a psi b))
 | lc_a_Proj1 : forall (psi:grade) (a:tm),
     (lc_tm a) ->
     (lc_tm (a_Proj1 psi a))
 | lc_a_Proj2 : forall (psi:grade) (a:tm),
     (lc_tm a) ->
     (lc_tm (a_Proj2 psi a))
 | lc_a_Bool :
     (lc_tm a_Bool)
 | lc_a_True :
     (lc_tm a_True)
 | lc_a_False :
     (lc_tm a_False)
 | lc_a_If : forall (a b0 b1:tm),
     (lc_tm a) ->
     (lc_tm b0) ->
     (lc_tm b1) ->
     (lc_tm (a_If a b0 b1)).

Fixpoint fv_tm (a5:tm) : vars :=
  match a5 with
  | a_TyUnit => {}
  | a_TmUnit => {}
  | (a_Pi psi A B) => (fv_tm A) \u (fv_tm B)
  | (a_Abs psi A a) => (fv_tm A) \u (fv_tm a)
  | (a_App a psi b) => (fv_tm a) \u (fv_tm b)
  | (a_Type s) => {}
  | (a_Var_b nat) => {}
  | (a_Var_f x) => {{x}}
  | (a_CEq psi a b psi0 A) => (fv_tm a) \u (fv_tm b) \u (fv_tm A)
  | a_Refl => {}
  | (a_Transp a b) => (fv_tm a) \u (fv_tm b)
  | (a_T psi A) => (fv_tm A)
  | (a_Box psi a) => (fv_tm a)
  | (a_Unbox psi a) => (fv_tm a)
  | (a_SSigma psi A B) => (fv_tm A) \u (fv_tm B)
  | (a_SPair a psi b) => (fv_tm a) \u (fv_tm b)
  | (a_Proj1 psi a) => (fv_tm a)
  | (a_Proj2 psi a) => (fv_tm a)
  | a_Bool => {}
  | a_True => {}
  | a_False => {}
  | (a_If a b0 b1) => (fv_tm a) \u (fv_tm b0) \u (fv_tm b1)
end.

Fixpoint subst_tm (a5:tm) (x5:tmvar) (a_6:tm) {struct a_6} : tm :=
  match a_6 with
  | a_TyUnit => a_TyUnit
  | a_TmUnit => a_TmUnit
  | (a_Pi psi A B) => a_Pi psi (subst_tm a5 x5 A) (subst_tm a5 x5 B)
  | (a_Abs psi A a) => a_Abs psi (subst_tm a5 x5 A) (subst_tm a5 x5 a)
  | (a_App a psi b) => a_App (subst_tm a5 x5 a) psi (subst_tm a5 x5 b)
  | (a_Type s) => a_Type s
  | (a_Var_b nat) => a_Var_b nat
  | (a_Var_f x) => (if eq_var x x5 then a5 else (a_Var_f x))
  | (a_CEq psi a b psi0 A) => a_CEq psi (subst_tm a5 x5 a) (subst_tm a5 x5 b) psi0 (subst_tm a5 x5 A)
  | a_Refl => a_Refl
  | (a_Transp a b) => a_Transp (subst_tm a5 x5 a) (subst_tm a5 x5 b)
  | (a_T psi A) => a_T psi (subst_tm a5 x5 A)
  | (a_Box psi a) => a_Box psi (subst_tm a5 x5 a)
  | (a_Unbox psi a) => a_Unbox psi (subst_tm a5 x5 a)
  | (a_SSigma psi A B) => a_SSigma psi (subst_tm a5 x5 A) (subst_tm a5 x5 B)
  | (a_SPair a psi b) => a_SPair (subst_tm a5 x5 a) psi (subst_tm a5 x5 b)
  | (a_Proj1 psi a) => a_Proj1 psi (subst_tm a5 x5 a)
  | (a_Proj2 psi a) => a_Proj2 psi (subst_tm a5 x5 a)
  | a_Bool => a_Bool
  | a_True => a_True
  | a_False => a_False
  | (a_If a b0 b1) => a_If (subst_tm a5 x5 a) (subst_tm a5 x5 b0) (subst_tm a5 x5 b1)
end.

Definition labels : context -> econtext :=
  map (fun '(u , s) => u).

Definition subst_ctx (a : tm) (x:var) : context -> context :=
  map (fun '(g, A) => (g, (subst_tm a x A))).

Definition tm_to_headform (a : tm) : option headform :=
  match a with
  | a_Abs _ _ _ => Some h_Abs
  | a_Pi psi _ _ => Some (h_Pi psi)
  | a_Type s => Some (h_Type s)
  | a_CEq psi _ _ psi0 _ => Some (h_CEq psi psi0)
  | a_Refl => Some h_Refl
  | a_Box psi _ => Some (h_Box psi)
  | a_T psi _ => Some (h_T psi)
  | a_SPair _ _ _ => Some h_SPair
  | a_SSigma psi _ _ => Some (h_SSigma psi)
  | a_TyUnit => Some h_TyUnit
  | a_TmUnit => Some h_TmUnit
  | a_Bool => Some h_Bool
  | a_True => Some h_True
  | a_False => Some h_False
  | _ => None
  end.

Definition Consistent (a b : tm) : Prop :=
  match tm_to_headform a, tm_to_headform b with
  | Some h1, Some h2 => h1 = h2
  | _, _ => True
  end.

Definition Value (a : tm) : bool :=
  match a with
  | a_SPair _ _ _ => true
  | a_SSigma _ _ _ => true
  | a_Pi _ _ _ => true
  | a_Abs _ _ _ => true
  | a_Type _ => true
  | a_CEq _ _ _ _ _ => true
  | a_Refl => true
  | a_Box psi _ => true
  | a_T psi _ => true
  | a_TyUnit => true
  | a_TmUnit => true
  | a_Bool => true
  | a_True => true
  | a_False => true
  | _ => false
  end.

Inductive P_sub : econtext -> econtext -> Prop :=
 | P_Empty :
     P_sub  nil   nil
 | P_Cons : forall (P1:econtext) (x:tmvar) (psi1:grade) (P2:econtext) (psi2:grade),
      ( psi1  <=  psi2 )  ->
     P_sub P1 P2 ->
      ~ AtomSetImpl.In  x  (dom  P1 )  ->
      ~ AtomSetImpl.In  x  (dom  P2 )  ->
     P_sub  (  ( x ~ psi1 )  ++ P1 )   (  ( x ~ psi2 )  ++ P2 ) .

Inductive P_meet : econtext -> econtext -> econtext -> Prop :=
 | PM_Empty :
     P_meet  nil   nil   nil
 | PM_Cons : forall (P1:econtext) (x:tmvar) (psi1:grade) (P2:econtext) (psi2:grade) (P3:econtext),
     P_meet P1 P2 P3 ->
     P_meet  (  (  ( x ~ psi1 )  ++ P1 )  )   (  (  ( x ~ psi2 )  ++ P2 )  )   (  (  ( x ~  ( psi1  `&`  psi2 )  )  ++ P3 )  ) .

Inductive ctx_sub : context -> context -> Prop :=
 | CS_Empty :
     ctx_sub  nil   nil
 | CS_ConsTm : forall (W1:context) (x:tmvar) (psi1:grade) (A:tm) (W2:context) (psi2:grade),
      ( psi1  <=  psi2 )  ->
     ctx_sub W1 W2 ->
      ~ AtomSetImpl.In  x  (dom  W1 )  ->
      ~ AtomSetImpl.In  x  (dom  W2 )  ->
     ctx_sub  (  ( x ~( psi1 , A ))  ++ W1 )   (  ( x ~( psi2 , A ))  ++ W2 ) .

Inductive GDefEq : econtext -> grade -> tm -> tm -> Prop :=
 | GE_Var : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (x:tmvar) (psi0:grade),
      uniq  P  ->
      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
      binds  x   psi0   P  ->
     GDefEq P psi (a_Var_f x) (a_Var_f x)
 | GE_Type : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (s:sort),
      uniq  P  ->
     GDefEq P psi (a_Type s) (a_Type s)
 | GE_Sym : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (b a:tm),
     GDefEq P psi a b ->
     GDefEq P psi b a
 | GE_Trans : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a b b0:tm),
     GDefEq P psi a b0 ->
     GDefEq P psi b0 b ->
     GDefEq P psi a b
 | GE_App : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (b0:tm) (psi0:grade) (a0 b1 a1:tm),
     GDefEq P psi b0 b1 ->
     CGDefEq P psi psi0 a0 a1 ->
     GDefEq P psi (a_App b0 psi0 a0) (a_App b1 psi0 a1)
 | GE_Abs : forall (L:vars) (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (A0 b0 A1 b1:tm),
     lc_tm A0 ->
     lc_tm A1 ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> GDefEq  (  ( x ~ psi0 )  ++ P )  psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm b0 (a_Var_f x) )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm b1 (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     GDefEq P psi (a_Abs psi0 A0 b0) (a_Abs psi0 A1 b1)
 | GE_Pi : forall (L:vars) (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (A0 B0 A1 B1:tm),
     GDefEq P psi A0 A1 ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> GDefEq  (  ( x ~ psi0 )  ++ P )  psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm B0 (a_Var_f x) )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm B1 (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     GDefEq P psi (a_Pi psi0 A0 B0) (a_Pi psi0 A1 B1)
 | GE_AppAbs : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a:tm) (psi0:grade) (b0 a0 b1 A:tm),
     GDefEq P psi a (a_Abs psi0 A a0) ->
     CGDefEq P psi psi0 b0 b1 ->
     GDefEq P psi (a_App a psi0 b0)  (open_tm_wrt_tm  a0   b1 )
 | GE_Refl : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade),
      uniq  P  ->
     GDefEq P psi a_Refl a_Refl
 | GE_Transp : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a0 b0 a1 b1:tm),
     GDefEq P psi a0 a1 ->
     GDefEq P psi b0 b1 ->
     GDefEq P psi (a_Transp a0 b0) (a_Transp a1 b1)
 | GE_CEq : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a0 b0:tm) (psi1:grade) (A0 a1 b1 A1:tm),
     lc_tm A0 ->
     lc_tm A1 ->
     GDefEq P psi a0 a1 ->
     GDefEq P psi b0 b1 ->
      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
     GDefEq P psi (a_CEq psi0 a0 b0 psi1 A0) (a_CEq psi0 a1 b1 psi1 A1)
 | GE_TranspRefl : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a0 b0 b1:tm),
     GDefEq P psi a0 a_Refl ->
     GDefEq P psi b0 b1 ->
     GDefEq P psi (a_Transp a0 b0) b1
 | GE_T : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (A B:tm),
     GDefEq P psi A B ->
     GDefEq P psi (a_T psi0 A) (a_T psi0 B)
 | GE_Box : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a b:tm),
     CGDefEq P psi psi0 a b ->
     GDefEq P psi (a_Box psi0 a) (a_Box psi0 b)
 | GE_Unbox : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a b:tm),
     GDefEq P psi a b ->
      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
     GDefEq P psi (a_Unbox psi0 a) (a_Unbox psi0 b)
 | GE_UnboxBox : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a b:tm),
     GDefEq P psi a (a_Box psi0 b) ->
      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
     GDefEq P psi (a_Unbox psi0 a) b
 | GE_Proj1Cong : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a0 a1:tm),
     GDefEq P psi a0 a1 ->
      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
     GDefEq P psi (a_Proj1 psi0 a0) (a_Proj1 psi0 a1)
 | GE_Proj2Cong : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a0 a1:tm),
     GDefEq P psi a0 a1 ->
     GDefEq P psi (a_Proj2 psi0 a0) (a_Proj2 psi0 a1)
 | GE_Proj1Beta : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (b a1 a2:tm),
     GDefEq P psi b (a_SPair a1 psi0 a2) ->
      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
     GDefEq P psi (a_Proj1 psi0 b) a1
 | GE_Proj2Beta : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (b a2 a1:tm),
     GDefEq P psi b (a_SPair a1 psi0 a2) ->
     GDefEq P psi (a_Proj2 psi0 b) a2
 | GE_SPair : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a0:tm) (psi0:grade) (b0 a1 b1:tm),
     CGDefEq P psi psi0 a0 a1 ->
     GDefEq P psi b0 b1 ->
     GDefEq P psi (a_SPair a0 psi0 b0) (a_SPair a1 psi0 b1)
 | GE_SSigma : forall (L:vars) (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (A0 B0 A1 B1:tm),
     GDefEq P psi A0 A1 ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> GDefEq  (  ( x ~ psi0 )  ++ P )  psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm B0 (a_Var_f x) )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm B1 (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     GDefEq P psi (a_SSigma psi0 A0 B0) (a_SSigma psi0 A1 B1)
 | GE_TyUnit : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade),
      uniq  P  ->
     GDefEq P psi a_TyUnit a_TyUnit
 | GE_TmUnit : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade),
      uniq  P  ->
     GDefEq P psi a_TmUnit a_TmUnit
 | GE_Bool : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade),
      uniq  P  ->
     GDefEq P psi a_Bool a_Bool
 | GE_True : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade),
      uniq  P  ->
     GDefEq P psi a_True a_True
 | GE_False : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade),
      uniq  P  ->
     GDefEq P psi a_False a_False
 | GE_If : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a0 b0 b1 a1 b2 b3:tm),
     GDefEq P psi a0 a1 ->
     GDefEq P psi b0 b2 ->
     GDefEq P psi b1 b3 ->
     GDefEq P psi (a_If a0 b0 b1) (a_If a1 b2 b3)
 | GE_IfTrue : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a0 b0 b1 b2 b3:tm),
     GDefEq P psi a0 a_True ->
     GDefEq P psi b0 b2 ->
     GDefEq P psi b1 b3 ->
     GDefEq P psi (a_If a0 b0 b1) b2
 | GE_IfFalse : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a0 b0 b1 b3 b2:tm),
     GDefEq P psi a0 a_False ->
     GDefEq P psi b0 b2 ->
     GDefEq P psi b1 b3 ->
     GDefEq P psi (a_If a0 b0 b1) b3
with CGDefEq : econtext -> grade -> grade -> tm -> tm -> Prop :=
 | CGE_Leq : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a b:tm),
      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
     GDefEq P psi a b ->
     CGDefEq P psi psi0 a b
 | CGE_NLeq : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a b:tm),
     lc_tm a ->
     lc_tm b ->
      not ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
      uniq  P  ->
     CGDefEq P psi psi0 a b.

Inductive DefEq : econtext -> tm -> tm -> Prop :=
 | E_One : forall (P:econtext) (a b:tm) (psi:grade),
     GDefEq P psi a b ->
     DefEq P a b
 | E_Trans : forall (P:econtext) (a b b0:tm),
     DefEq P a b0 ->
     DefEq P b0 b ->
     DefEq P a b.

Inductive Ctx : context -> Prop :=
 | Ctx_Empty :
     Ctx  nil
 | Ctx_Cons : forall (W:context) (x:tmvar) (psi0:grade) (A:tm) (psi:grade) (s:sort),
     Ctx W ->
     Typing W psi A (a_Type s) ->
      ~ AtomSetImpl.In  x  (dom  W )  ->
     Ctx  (  ( x ~( psi0 , A ))  ++ W )
with Typing : context -> grade -> tm -> tm -> Prop :=
 | T_Type : forall (W:context) (psi:grade) (s1 s2:sort),
     Ctx W ->
      axiom  s1   s2  ->
     Typing W psi (a_Type s1) (a_Type s2)
 | T_Var : forall (W:context) (psi:grade) (x:tmvar) (A:tm) (psi0:grade),
     Ctx W ->
      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
      binds  x  ( psi0 ,  A )  W  ->
     Typing W psi (a_Var_f x) A
 | T_Pi : forall (L:vars) (W:context) (psi psi0:grade) (A B:tm) (s3 s1 s2:sort),
     Typing W psi A (a_Type s1) ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> Typing  (  ( x ~( psi0 , A ))  ++ W )  psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f x) )  (a_Type s2) )  ->
      rule_pi  s1   s2   s3  ->
     Typing W psi (a_Pi psi0 A B) (a_Type s3)
 | T_Abs : forall (L:vars) (W:context) (psi psi0:grade) (A b B:tm) (psi1:grade) (s:sort),
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> Typing  (  ( x ~( psi0 , A ))  ++ W )  psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm b (a_Var_f x) )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     Typing W psi1  ( (a_Pi psi0 A B) )  (a_Type s) ->
     Typing W psi (a_Abs psi0 A b) (a_Pi psi0 A B)
 | T_App : forall (W:context) (psi:grade) (b:tm) (psi0:grade) (a B A:tm),
     Typing W psi b (a_Pi psi0 A B) ->
     Typing W psi0 a A ->
     Typing W psi (a_App b psi0 a)  (open_tm_wrt_tm  B   a )
 | T_Conv : forall (W:context) (psi:grade) (a B A:tm) (psi0:grade) (s:sort),
     Typing W psi a A ->
     Typing W psi0 B (a_Type s) ->
     DefEq  (labels  W )  A B ->
     Typing W psi a B
 | T_Refl : forall (W:context) (psi psi0:grade) (a:tm) (psi1:grade) (A:tm) (psi2:grade) (s:sort),
     Typing W psi2  (a_CEq psi0 a a psi1 A)  (a_Type s) ->
     Typing W psi a_Refl  (a_CEq psi0 a a psi1 A)
 | T_CEq : forall (W:context) (psi psi0:grade) (a b:tm) (psi1:grade) (A:tm) (s2:sort) (psi2:grade) (s1:sort),
     Typing W psi1 a A ->
     Typing W psi1 b A ->
     Typing W psi2 A (a_Type s1) ->
      rule_eq  s1   s2  ->
      ( psi1  <=  psi0 )  ->
      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
     Typing W psi  (a_CEq psi0 a b psi1 A)  (a_Type s2)
 | T_Transp : forall (L:vars) (W:context) (psi:grade) (a b B a1:tm) (psi0:grade) (A:tm) (psi1:grade) (s:sort) (a0:tm) (psi2:grade) (s1:sort),
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> Typing  (  ( x ~( psi1 , A ))  ++ W )  psi0  ( open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f x) )  (a_Type s) )  ->
     Typing W psi a  (a_CEq psi0 a0 a1 psi1 A)  ->
     Typing W psi b  (open_tm_wrt_tm  B   a0 )  ->
      Typing W psi2 A (a_Type s1)  ->
     Typing W psi (a_Transp a b)  (open_tm_wrt_tm  B   a1 )
 | T_T : forall (W:context) (psi psi0:grade) (A:tm) (s2 s1:sort),
     Typing W psi A (a_Type s1) ->
      rule_t  s1   s2  ->
     Typing W psi (a_T psi0 A) (a_Type s2)
 | T_Box : forall (W:context) (psi psi0:grade) (a A:tm) (psi1:grade) (s:sort),
     Typing W psi0 a A ->
     Typing W psi1 (a_T psi0 A) (a_Type s) ->
     Typing W psi (a_Box psi0 a) (a_T psi0 A)
 | T_Unbox : forall (W:context) (psi psi0:grade) (a A:tm),
     Typing W psi a (a_T psi0 A) ->
      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
     Typing W psi (a_Unbox psi0 a) A
 | T_SSigma : forall (L:vars) (W:context) (psi psi0:grade) (A B:tm) (s3 s1 s2:sort),
     Typing W psi A (a_Type s1) ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> Typing  (  ( x ~( psi0 , A ))  ++ W )  psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f x) )  (a_Type s2) )  ->
      rule_sig  s1   s2   s3  ->
     Typing W psi (a_SSigma psi0 A B) (a_Type s3)
 | T_SPair : forall (W:context) (psi:grade) (a:tm) (psi0:grade) (b A B:tm) (psi1:grade) (s:sort),
     Typing W psi1 (a_SSigma psi0 A B) (a_Type s) ->
     Typing W psi0 a A ->
     Typing W psi b  (open_tm_wrt_tm  B   a )  ->
     Typing W psi (a_SPair a psi0 b) (a_SSigma psi0 A B)
 | T_Proj1 : forall (W:context) (psi psi0:grade) (a A B:tm),
     Typing W psi a (a_SSigma psi0 A B) ->
      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
     Typing W psi (a_Proj1 psi0 a) A
 | T_Proj2 : forall (W:context) (psi psi0:grade) (a B A:tm),
     Typing W psi a (a_SSigma psi0 A B) ->
     Typing W psi0 (a_Proj1 psi0 a) A ->
     Typing W psi (a_Proj2 psi0 a)  (open_tm_wrt_tm  B   (a_Proj1 psi0 a) )
 | T_TyUnit : forall (W:context) (psi:grade) (s:sort),
     Ctx W ->
      rule_unit  s  ->
     Typing W psi a_TyUnit (a_Type s)
 | T_TmUnit : forall (W:context) (psi psi0:grade) (s:sort),
     Typing W psi0 a_TyUnit (a_Type s) ->
     Typing W psi a_TmUnit a_TyUnit
 | T_Bool : forall (W:context) (psi:grade) (s:sort),
     Ctx W ->
      rule_bool  s  ->
     Typing W psi a_Bool (a_Type s)
 | T_True : forall (W:context) (psi psi0:grade) (s:sort),
     Typing W psi0 a_Bool (a_Type s) ->
     Typing W psi a_True a_Bool
 | T_False : forall (W:context) (psi psi0:grade) (s:sort),
     Typing W psi0 a_Bool (a_Type s) ->
     Typing W psi a_False a_Bool
 | T_If : forall (W:context) (psi:grade) (a b0 b1 A:tm),
     Typing W psi a a_Bool ->
     Typing W psi b0 A ->
     Typing W psi b1 A ->
     Typing W psi (a_If a b0 b1) A.

Inductive Red : tm -> tm -> Prop :=
 | R_App : forall (a0:tm) (psi0:grade) (b a1:tm),
     lc_tm b ->
     Red a0 a1 ->
     Red (a_App a0 psi0 b) (a_App a1 psi0 b)
 | R_AppAbs : forall (psi0:grade) (A a b:tm),
     lc_tm A ->
     lc_tm (a_Abs psi0 A a) ->
     lc_tm b ->
     Red (a_App  ( (a_Abs psi0 A a) )  psi0 b)  (open_tm_wrt_tm  a   b )
 | R_Transp : forall (a b a0:tm),
     lc_tm b ->
     Red a a0 ->
     Red (a_Transp a b) (a_Transp a0 b)
 | R_TranspRefl : forall (a:tm),
     lc_tm a ->
     Red (a_Transp a_Refl a) a
 | R_Unbox : forall (psi0:grade) (a a0:tm),
     Red a a0 ->
     Red (a_Unbox psi0 a) (a_Unbox psi0 a0)
 | R_UnboxBox : forall (psi0:grade) (a:tm),
     lc_tm a ->
     Red (a_Unbox psi0  ( (a_Box psi0 a) ) ) a
 | R_Proj1Cong : forall (psi:grade) (a a':tm),
     Red a a' ->
     Red (a_Proj1 psi a) (a_Proj1 psi a')
 | R_Proj2Cong : forall (psi:grade) (a a':tm),
     Red a a' ->
     Red (a_Proj2 psi a) (a_Proj2 psi a')
 | R_Proj1Beta : forall (psi:grade) (a1 a2:tm),
     lc_tm a2 ->
     lc_tm a1 ->
     Red (a_Proj1 psi (a_SPair a1 psi a2)) a1
 | R_Proj2Beta : forall (psi:grade) (a1 a2:tm),
     lc_tm a1 ->
     lc_tm a2 ->
     Red (a_Proj2 psi (a_SPair a1 psi a2)) a2
 | R_If : forall (a b0 b1 a':tm),
     lc_tm b0 ->
     lc_tm b1 ->
     Red a a' ->
     Red (a_If a b0 b1) (a_If a' b0 b1)
 | R_IfTrue : forall (b0 b1:tm),
     lc_tm b1 ->
     lc_tm b0 ->
     Red (a_If a_True b0 b1) b0
 | R_IfFalse : forall (b0 b1:tm),
     lc_tm b0 ->
     lc_tm b1 ->
     Red (a_If a_False b0 b1) b1.

Inductive Reds : tm -> tm -> Prop :=
 | Rs_Refl : forall (a:tm),
     lc_tm a ->
     Reds a a
 | Rs_Step : forall (a0 a1 b:tm),
     Red a0 b ->
     Reds b a1 ->
     Reds a0 a1.

Inductive CPar : econtext -> grade -> grade -> tm -> tm -> Prop :=
 | CPar_Leq : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a1 a2:tm),
      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
     Par P psi a1 a2 ->
     CPar P psi psi0 a1 a2
 | CPar_Nleq : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a1 a2:tm),
     lc_tm a1 ->
     lc_tm a2 ->
      not ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
      uniq  P  ->
     CPar P psi psi0 a1 a2
with Par : econtext -> grade -> tm -> tm -> Prop :=
 | Par_Var : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (x:tmvar) (psi0:grade),
      uniq  P  ->
      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
      binds  x   psi0   P  ->
     Par P psi (a_Var_f x) (a_Var_f x)
 | Par_Type : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (s:sort),
      uniq  P  ->
     Par P psi (a_Type s) (a_Type s)
 | Par_Pi : forall (L:vars) (P:econtext) (psi psi1:grade) (A1 B1 A2 B2:tm),
     Par P psi A1 A2 ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> Par  (  ( x ~ psi1 )  ++ P )  psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm B1 (a_Var_f x) )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm B2 (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     Par P psi (a_Pi psi1 A1 B1) (a_Pi psi1 A2 B2)
 | Par_AppBeta : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a:tm) (psi0:grade) (b a' b' A:tm),
     Par P psi a  ( (a_Abs psi0 A a') )  ->
     CPar P psi psi0 b b' ->
     Par P psi (a_App a psi0 b)  (open_tm_wrt_tm  a'   b' )
 | Par_App : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a:tm) (psi0:grade) (b a' b':tm),
     Par P psi a a' ->
     CPar P psi psi0 b b' ->
     Par P psi (a_App a psi0 b) (a_App a' psi0 b')
 | Par_Abs : forall (L:vars) (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (A1 b1 A2 b2:tm),
     lc_tm A1 ->
     lc_tm A2 ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> Par  (  ( x ~ psi0 )  ++ P )  psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm b1 (a_Var_f x) )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm b2 (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     Par P psi (a_Abs psi0 A1 b1) (a_Abs psi0 A2 b2)
 | Par_Refl : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade),
      uniq  P  ->
     Par P psi a_Refl a_Refl
 | Par_Transp : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a0 b0 a1 b1:tm),
     Par P psi a0 a1 ->

/bin/bash -lc "sed -i 's/(open_as_subst a u H)/(@open_as_subst a x u H)/' Task.v
python3 - <<'PY'
s=open('Qualitative_ott.v').read().split('Inductive CPar :',1)[1].split('Inductive EPar',1)[0]
s='Inductive CStep :'+s
import re
s=re.sub(r'\\bCPar', 'CStep', s)
s=re.sub(r'\\bPar', 'PStep', s)
s=re.sub(r'"'^'"\\s*uniq  P  ->\\n', '', s, flags=re.M)
with open('Task.v','a') as o:
 o.write('''
(* Parallel reduction with unrestricted context weakening. *)
'''+s+'''
Scheme ps_ind := Induction for PStep Sort Prop
with cs_ind := Induction for CStep Sort Prop.
Combined Scheme pcs_ind from ps_ind, cs_ind.

Local Hint Constructors PStep CStep : ni.

Local Lemma meet_left p q : p "'`&` q <= p.
Proof. exact: Order.leIl. Qed.
Local Lemma meet_right p q : p `&` q <= q.
Proof. exact: Order.leIr. Qed.
Local Lemma meet_bound p q g : g <= p -> g <= q -> g <= p `&` q.
Proof. intros; by rewrite Order.leI H H0. Qed.
Local Lemma below_trans p q r : p <= q -> q <= r -> p <= r.
Proof. exact: Order.le_trans. Qed.
Local Hint Resolve meet_left meet_right meet_bound below_trans Order.lexx : ni.

Local Lemma pstep_lc :
  (forall P p a b, PStep P p a b -> lc_tm a /'"\\\\ lc_tm b) /\\\\
  (forall P p g a b, CStep P p g a b -> lc_tm a /\\\\ lc_tm b).
Proof.
  apply pcs_ind; intros; repeat match goal with H : _ /\\\\ _ |- _ => destruct H end;
    try solve [split; eauto 5 with ni].
  - split; apply lc_a_Pi; auto; intros x;
      pick fresh z for L;
      apply (lc_from_open (x:=z)); edestruct H0; eauto.
  - split; [eauto with ni|].
    match goal with H : lc_tm (a_Abs _ _ ?a) |- lc_tm (open_tm_wrt_tm ?a _) =>
      inversion H; subst;
      pick fresh x for (fv_tm a); eapply lc_open_with; eauto
    end.
  - split; apply lc_a_Abs; auto; intros x;
      pick fresh z for L;
      apply (lc_from_open (x:=z)); edestruct H1; eauto.
  - split; apply lc_a_SSigma; auto; intros x;
      pick fresh z for L;
      apply (lc_from_open (x:=z)); edestruct H0; eauto.
Qed.

Local Lemma ps_lc P p a b : PStep P p a b -> lc_tm a /\\\\ lc_tm b.
Proof. apply pstep_lc. Qed.
Local Lemma cs_lc P p g a b : CStep P p g a b -> lc_tm a /\\\\ lc_tm b.
Proof. apply pstep_lc. Qed.

Local Definition ctx_incl (P Q : econtext) :=
  forall x g, binds x g P -> binds x g Q.

Local Lemma ctx_incl_cons P Q x g :
  ctx_incl P Q -> ctx_incl ((x ~ g) ++ P) ((x ~ g) ++ Q).
Proof.
  intros H y j Hy. apply binds_app_iff in Hy.
  apply binds_app_iff. intuition.
Qed.

Local Lemma pstep_weaken :
  (forall P p a b, PStep P p a b -> forall Q, ctx_incl P Q -> PStep Q p a b) /\\\\
  (forall P p g a b, CStep P p g a b -> forall Q, ctx_incl P Q -> CStep Q p g a b).
Proof.
  apply pcs_ind; unfold ctx_incl at 1; intros;
    eauto 8 using ctx_incl_cons with ni.
Qed.

Local Lemma ps_weaken P p a b Q :

  forall y j, binds y j P -> (y = x -> j = g) /\\ (y <> x -> binds y j Q).

Local Inductive scoped : econtext -> grade -> tm -> Prop :=
| S_Var P p x g : g <= p -> binds x g P -> scoped P p (a_Var_f x)
| S_Type P p s : scoped P p (a_Type s)
| S_Pi L P p g A B : scoped P p A ->
    (forall x, x \\notin L -> scoped ((x ~ g) ++ P) p (open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f x))) ->
    scoped P p (a_Pi g A B)
| S_Abs L P p g A b : lc_tm A ->
    (forall x, x \\notin L -> scoped ((x ~ g) ++ P) p (open_tm_wrt_tm b (a_Var_f x))) ->
    scoped P p (a_Abs g A b)
| S_App P p g a b : scoped P p a -> scoped P g b -> scoped P p (a_App a g b)
| S_CEq P p h g a b A : h <= p -> g <= h ->
    scoped P g a -> scoped P g b -> lc_tm A -> scoped P p (a_CEq h a b g A)
| S_Refl P p : scoped P p a_Refl
| S_Transp P p a b : scoped P p a -> scoped P p b -> scoped P p (a_Transp a b)
| S_T P p g A : scoped P p A -> scoped P p (a_T g A)
| S_Box P p g a : scoped P g a -> scoped P p (a_Box g a)
| S_Unbox P p g a : g <= p -> scoped P p a -> scoped P p (a_Unbox g a)
| S_SSigma L P p g A B : scoped P p A ->
    (forall x, x \\notin L -> scoped ((x ~ g) ++ P) p (open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f x))) ->
    scoped P p (a_SSigma g A B)
| S_SPair P p g a b : scoped P g a -> scoped P p b -> scoped P p (a_SPair a g b)
| S_Proj1 P p g a : g <= p -> scoped P p a -> scoped P p (a_Proj1 g a)
| S_Proj2 P p g a : scoped P p a -> scoped P p (a_Proj2 g a)
| S_TyUnit P p : scoped P p a_TyUnit
| S_TmUnit P p : scoped P p a_TmUnit
| S_Bool P p : scoped P p a_Bool
| S_True P p : scoped P p a_True
| S_False P p : scoped P p a_False
| S_If P p a b c : scoped P p a -> scoped P p b -> scoped P p c -> scoped P p (a_If a b c).

Local Lemma scoped_refl P p a :

    try solve [eauto 3 using below_trans with ni].

Local Definition grade_eq P p := stable_eq (PStep P p).
Local Definition conditional_eq P p g := stable_eq (CStep P p g).

Local Lemma grade_eq_step P p a b : PStep P p a b -> grade_eq P p a b.
Proof.
  intro H. split; [eauto using ps_refl_left|]. split; eauto using ps_refl_right, eq_edge.
Qed.

Local Lemma conditional_eq_step P p g a b : CStep P p g a b -> conditional_eq P p g a b.
Proof.
  intro H. destruct (proj2 ps_refl_both _ _ _ _ _ H).
  repeat split; eauto using eq_edge.
Qed.

Local Lemma grade_eq_c P p g a b :
  g <= p -> grade_eq P p a b -> conditional_eq P p g a b.
Proof.
  intros Hp H. exact (stable_map (f:=fun t => t) ltac:(eauto using CStep_Leq) H).
Qed.

Local Lemma grade_eq_app P p g a b c d :
  grade_eq P p a b -> conditional_eq P p g c d ->
  grade_eq P p (a_App a g c) (a_App b g d).
Proof.
  apply (stable_map2 (f:=fun x y => a_App x g y)); eauto using PStep_App.
Qed.

Local Lemma grade_eq_if P p a a' b b' c c' :
  grade_eq P p a a' -> grade_eq P p b b' -> grade_eq P p c c' ->
  grade_eq P p (a_If a b c) (a_If a' b' c').
Proof. apply (stable_map3 (f:=a_If)); eauto using PStep_If. Qed.

Local Lemma grade_eq_binder P p g L b b' :
  (forall x, x \\notin L -> grade_eq ((x ~ g) ++ P) p
     (open_tm_wrt_tm b (a_Var_f x)) (open_tm_wrt_tm b' (a_Var_f x))) ->
  exists x, x \\notin dom P /\\ x \\notin fv_tm b /\\ x \\notin fv_tm b' /\\
    grade_eq ((x ~ g) ++ P) p (open_tm_wrt_tm b (a_Var_f x))
                                (open_tm_wrt_tm b' (a_Var_f x)).
Proof.
  intros H. pick fresh x for (L \\u dom P \\u fv_tm b \\u fv_tm b').
  exists x; repeat split; try fsetdec; apply H; fsetdec.
Qed.

Scheme ge_ind := Induction for GDefEq Sort Prop
with cge_ind := Induction for CGDefEq Sort Prop.
Combined Scheme gcge_ind from ge_ind, cge_ind.

Local Lemma grade_eq_sound :
  (forall P p a b, GDefEq P p a b -> grade_eq P p a b) /\\
  (forall P p g a b, CGDefEq P p g a b -> conditional_eq P p g a b).
Proof.
  apply gcge_ind; intros.
  all: try solve [apply stable_refl; eauto 2 with ni].
  all: try solve [eauto 2 using stable_sym, stable_trans, grade_eq_app, grade_eq_if,
                                grade_eq_c, conditional_eq_step with ni].
  - destruct (grade_eq_binder H) as [x [Hx [Hb0 [Hb1 J]]]].
    eapply stable_trans with (b:=a_Abs psi0 A0 b1).
    + rewrite <- (@close_open_var b0 x Hb0), <- (@close_open_var b1 x Hb1).
      apply (stable_map (f:=fun b => a_Abs psi0 A0 (close_tm_wrt_tm x b))) in J;
        [exact J|].
      intros; eapply PStep_Abs with (L:={{x}}); eauto using ps_close.
    + apply grade_eq_step. eapply PStep_Abs with (L:=L); auto.

/bin/bash -lc "cat > /tmp/NI_conv.snip <<'EOF'

Local Lemma conv_step allow P p a b : allow p -> PStep P p a b -> conv allow P a b.
Proof. intros Hp H; apply eq_edge; exists p; auto. Qed.

Local Lemma conv_general P p a b :
  grade_eq P p a b -> conv_any P a b.
Proof.
  intros (_ & _ & H).
  exact (eq_map (f:=fun z=>z) (fun a b H => ex_intro _ p (conj I H)) H).
Qed.

Local Lemma defe_conv P a b : DefEq P a b -> conv_any P a b.
Proof.
  induction 1; eauto using path_cat.
  apply (conv_general (p:=psi)), (proj1 grade_eq_sound); assumption.
Qed.

Local Lemma conv_any_common P a b :
  uniq P -> conv_any P a b ->
  exists c, path (grade_step (fun _ => True) P) a c /\\
            path (grade_step (fun _ => True) P) b c.
Proof. intros; eapply conv_common; eauto. Qed.

Local Lemma path_conv allow P a b :
  path (grade_step allow P) a b -> conv allow P a b.
Proof.
  intro H; exact (path_map (f:=fun z=>z) (fun _ _ H => or_introl H) H).
Qed.

Local Lemma ps_head P p a b h :
  PStep P p a b -> tm_to_headform a = Some h -> tm_to_headform b = Some h.
Proof. destruct 1; simpl; intro E; try discriminate; exact E. Qed.

Local Lemma path_head allow P a b h :
  path (grade_step allow P) a b ->
  tm_to_headform a = Some h -> tm_to_headform b = Some h.
Proof.
  induction 1; auto. destruct H as [p [_ H]].
  eauto using ps_head.
Qed.

Local Lemma conv_heads P a b h k :
  uniq P -> conv_any P a b ->
  tm_to_headform a = Some h -> tm_to_headform b = Some k -> h = k.
Proof.
  intros HU HC Ha Hb.
  destruct (conv_any_common HU HC) as [c [Hac Hbc]].
  pose proof (path_head Hac Ha). pose proof (path_head Hbc Hb). congruence.
Qed.

Local Definition entails (P : econtext) a b :=
  path (grade_step (fun _ => True) P) a b.

Local Definition bind_type (is_pi : bool) := if is_pi then a_Pi else a_SSigma.

Local Lemma binder_path P a b : entails P a b ->
  forall flag g A B, a = bind_type flag g A B ->
  exists A' B' L, b = bind_type flag g A' B' /\\ entails P A A' /\\
    (forall x, x \\notin L -> entails ((x ~ g) ++ P)
      (open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f x)) (open_tm_wrt_tm B' (a_Var_f x))).
Proof.
  induction 1; intros f g A B E; subst.
  - exists A, B, empty. repeat split; constructor.
  - destruct H as [p [_ H]].

(* Typing with the formation premises needed for weak-head preservation. *)
Local Definition type_value (a : tm) : Prop :=
  match a with
  | a_Type _ | a_Pi _ _ _ | a_CEq _ _ _ _ _ | a_T _ _
  | a_SSigma _ _ _ | a_TyUnit | a_Bool => True
  | _ => False
  end.

Inductive well_typed : context -> grade -> tm -> tm -> Prop :=
| W_Formation W p a s : type_value a -> scoped (labels W) p a ->
    well_typed W p a (a_Type s)
| W_Var W p x g A : g <= p -> binds x (g, A) W ->
    well_typed W p (a_Var_f x) A
| W_Abs W p g A b B L : lc_tm A ->
    (forall x, x \\notin L -> well_typed ((x ~ (g,A)) ++ W) p
      (open_tm_wrt_tm b (a_Var_f x)) (open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f x))) ->
    well_typed W p (a_Abs g A b) (a_Pi g A B)
| W_App W p g a b A B : well_typed W p a (a_Pi g A B) ->
    well_typed W g b A -> well_typed W p (a_App a g b) (open_tm_wrt_tm B b)
| W_Conv W p a A B : well_typed W p a A -> conv_any (labels W) A B -> well_typed W p a B

Local Lemma subst_open_var a u x z :
  lc_tm u -> z <> x ->
  subst_tm u x (open_tm_wrt_tm a (a_Var_f z)) =
  open_tm_wrt_tm (subst_tm u x a) (a_Var_f z).
Proof.
  intros Hu Hn. rewrite subst_open by assumption.
  rewrite (@subst_fresh (a_Var_f z) x u) by (simpl; fsetdec).
  reflexivity.
Qed.

Local Lemma wt_subst W p a A :
  well_typed W p a A -> forall V x g U u,
  remove_type W V x g U u -> x \\notin fv_tm U -> well_typed V g u U ->
  well_typed V p (subst_tm u x a) (subst_tm u x A).
Proof.
  induction 1; intros V x0 j U u Hr Hf Hu;
    assert (HS := wt_scoped Hu);
    assert (HL := scoped_lc HS);
    simpl in *; repeat rewrite subst_open by exact HL.
  all: try solve [eapply W_Formation;
    [destruct a; simpl in *; tauto|eauto using scoped_subst, remove_type_labels]].
  all: try solve [eapply W_Conv; eauto using conv_subst, remove_type_labels].
  all: try solve [eapply W_App; eauto].
  all: try solve [apply W_Refl].
  all: try solve [eapply W_Box; eauto].
  all: try solve [eapply W_Unbox; eauto].
  all: try solve [eapply W_SPair; eauto].
  all: try solve [eapply W_Proj1; eauto].
  all: try solve [apply W_Unit || apply W_True || apply W_False].
  all: try solve [eapply W_If; eauto].
  - decide_atoms; subst;
      match goal with K : binds _ _ _ |- _ => destruct (Hr _ _ _ K) as [E D] end.
    + specialize (E eq_refl) as [-> ->].
      rewrite subst_fresh by assumption. eauto using wt_mono.
    + eapply W_Var; eauto.
  - eapply W_Abs with (L:=L \\u {{x0}}).
    + auto using lc_subst.
    + intros z Hz.
      rewrite <- "'!(@subst_open_var _ u x0 z) by (auto; fsetdec).
      eapply H0; [fsetdec|eapply remove_type_cons; [exact Hr|fsetdec]
                          |exact Hf|auto using wt_weaken_cons].
  - eapply W_Transp with (L:=L '"\\u {{x0}}); eauto 4 using scoped_subst, remove_type_labels.
    intros z Hz. rewrite <- (@subst_open_var _ u x0 z) by (auto; fsetdec).
    eapply scoped_subst; [apply H2; fsetdec| |apply scoped_weaken_cons; exact HS].
    exact (remove_var_cons (remove_type_labels Hr) ltac:(fsetdec)).
  - eapply W_Proj2 with (L:=L \\u {{x0}}); eauto 4 using scoped_subst, remove_type_labels.
    intros z Hz. rewrite <- (@subst_open_var _ u x0 z) by (auto; fsetdec).
    eapply scoped_subst; [apply H0; fsetdec| |apply scoped_weaken_cons; exact HS].
    exact (remove_var_cons (remove_type_labels Hr) ltac:(fsetdec)).
Qed.

Local Fixpoint context_fv (W : context) : vars :=
  match W with
  | nil => empty
  | (_,(_,A)) :: W => fv_tm A \\u context_fv W
  end.

Local Lemma ctx_subst_fresh W x u :
  x \\notin context_fv W -> subst_ctx u x W = W.
Proof.
  induction W as [|[y [g A]] W IH]; simpl; auto.
  intro H. rewrite subst_fresh, IH by fsetdec. reflexivity.
Qed.

Local Lemma wt_open W p g A b B L u :
  (forall x, x \\notin L -> well_typed ((x ~ (g,A)) ++ W) p
    (open_tm_wrt_tm b (a_Var_f x)) (open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f x))) ->
  well_typed W g u A ->
  well_typed W p (open_tm_wrt_tm b u) (open_tm_wrt_tm B u).
Proof.
  intros H Hu.
  pick fresh x for (L \\u dom W \\u context_fv W \\u fv_tm A \\u fv_tm b \\u fv_tm B).
  rewrite (@open_as_subst b x u), (@open_as_subst B x u) by fsetdec.
  assert (E : subst_ctx u x W = W) by (apply ctx_subst_fresh; fsetdec).
  rewrite <- E at 1.
  eapply wt_subst with (W:=(x ~ (g,A)) ++ W) (g:=g) (U:=A).
  - apply H; fsetdec.
  - apply remove_type_head; fsetdec.
  - fsetdec.
  - rewrite E; exact Hu.
Qed.

Local Lemma conv_open P g B D L u :
  (forall x, x \\notin L -> conv_any ((x ~ g) ++ P)
    (open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f x)) (open_tm_wrt_tm D (a_Var_f x))) ->
  scoped P g u ->
  conv_any P (open_tm_wrt_tm B u) (open_tm_wrt_tm D u).
Proof.
  intros H Hu. pick fresh x for (L \\u dom P \\u fv_tm B \\u fv_tm D).
  rewrite (@open_as_subst B x u), (@open_as_subst D x u) by fsetdec.
  eapply conv_subst; [apply remove_var_head; fsetdec|exact Hu|apply H; fsetdec].
Qed.

Local Lemma conv_open_red P g p B L u v :
  (forall x, x \\notin L -> scoped ((x ~ g) ++ P) p (open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f x))) ->
  scoped P g u -> Red u v ->
  conv_any P (open_tm_wrt_tm B u) (open_tm_wrt_tm B v).
Proof.
  intros H Hu Hr. apply conv_step with (p:=p); [exact I|].
  eapply ps_open with (L:=L) (g:=g).
  - intros x Hx. apply scoped_ps, H, Hx.
  - destruct (red_scoped Hr Hu) as [Hv _].
    apply cs_intro; [eauto using scoped_lc|eauto using scoped_lc|].
    intro Hgp. apply (proj2 (red_scoped Hr (scoped_mono Hu Hgp))).
Qed.

Local Lemma conv_open_eq P g p B L u v :
  (forall x, x \\notin L -> scoped ((x ~ g) ++ P) p (open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f x))) ->
  g <= p -> grade_eq P p u v ->
  conv_any P (open_tm_wrt_tm B u) (open_tm_wrt_tm B v).
Proof.
  intros H Hg (_ & _ & He).
  eapply (eq_map (f:=open_tm_wrt_tm B)); [|exact He].
  intros s t Hst. exists p; split; [exact I|].
  eapply ps_open with (L:=L) (g:=g).
  - intros x Hx. apply scoped_ps, H, Hx.
  - apply CStep_Leq; assumption.
Qed.
